scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-expense-splitter "vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n emu,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run emulators" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build -w web && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build -w functions && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-expense-splitter --only firestore,functions,auth,storage "vitest run --config tests/integration/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config tests/integration/vitest.web.config.ts"
